My journey

Experience and individual approach

My professional journey began with a desire to understand law in a broader social context. During my studies, an internship at a law firm in Austria opened the door to precision and the high standards of European legal practice. It was there I understood that law must be, above all, functional and predictable.

I later developed my experience at leading law firms in Slovakia, where I worked on complex and diverse cases. This variety taught me that solutions are not just about strict paragraphs, but primarily about strategy built on understanding client needs.

At Noveris Legal, I return to what matters most – the personal relationship. My approach is based on an absolute commitment to the client. I don't just look for technically correct answers, but solutions that truly respect the integrity and life or business goals of those I represent.
